title: Projection-specific population information in parietal cortex
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Predict held-out single-neuron deconvolved PPC activity conditional on the original task and movement variables, preserving Figure 2b,c. Larger motif enrichment or interaction information is not itself better predictive performance.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Predict held-out single-neuron deconvolved PPC activity conditional on the original task and movement variables, preserving Figure 2b,c. Larger motif enrichment or interaction information is not itself better predictive performance.

Source-paper comparison for Figure 2 held-out fraction of deviance explained, with original per-neuron support and source normalization: Eq. 6 FDE=(L_model-L_null)/(L_sat-L_null), using held-out log-likelihoods. NPvC null uses the marginal activity density and its saturated term uses the peak over the source 200-point activity grid. GLM and NPvC have distinct source normalizers; preserve and audit those conventions rather than silently sharing a denominator.
success_criteria: Recover exact Figure 2 support, the original split protocol, fitted source preprocessing, likelihood normalizers and numeric NPvC baseline; unrecoverable historical random memberships alone do not bar a documented source-conformant rerun.

Compare candidate and author NPvC on identical held-out folds from the recovered source protocol, whether historical or documented regenerated draws, with the original population/aggregation and predeclared calibration tolerance, meaningful effect and uncertainty rule.
Retain GLM and original NPvC as separate baselines; beating GLM alone does not surpass the paper's NPvC result.
Do not reward higher motif enrichment, stronger p-values, graph-calculation fidelity, changed epochs or a held-animal extension as the same-task paper win.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.
participant_inputs: All70 released session files with trial-aligned neural responses, stimulus/task/behavior variables, projection identities and source eligibility. Raw imaging is unnecessary only if complete released analysis signals and their provenance satisfy every required panel.
